Total token supply, increased only through _mint and decreased through _burn

edges.reason: msg.sender is read and returned by Context._msgSender()
_msgSender() result is compared against _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier require statement
_owner state variable is read in onlyOwner to authorize the caller
onlyOwner gates execution of BigmacToken.mint
mint invokes ERC20._mint to create tokens
_to parameter supplied into mint
_amount parameter supplied into mint
_to is forwarded as the account argument of ERC20._mint
_amount is forwarded as the value argument of ERC20._mint
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add, an arithmetic state mutation
_mint credits the recipient entry in the _balances mapping
newOwner parameter is validated and assigned inside transferOwnership
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable
onlyOwner gates execution of renounceOwnership
renounceOwnership overwrites _owner with address(0)
owner() returns the _owner state variable
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine
_transfer mutates _balances using SafeMath sub and add operations
transferFrom delegates the balance move to _transfer
approve writes the _allowances mapping through _approve
transferFrom reads and decrements the _allowances mapping
sendValue performs a low-level call{value:} that transfers control to the recipient
The recipient can reenter the calling contract while the value transfer is in flight

normalization_plan.reason: Function-local address argument is only meaningful within mint; fold it into the mint function node before dataflow analysis
Amount argument used solely by mint and forwarded to _mint; merge into the mint function node
Ownership-candidate parameter exists only inside transferOwnership; collapse it into that function node to keep the core access-control graph compact
